note: Fallback rates only. js/fx.js fetches a live rate per currency, once per session, after the family country is known (Frankfurter v2, then ExchangeRate-API). This file is used only when both fail, with the message 'Could not update the exchange rate. Using the rate from DATE.' Only the demo currencies (BRL, INR) have a fallback, each from its official source. Every other currency is null and shows 'Not confirmed'. tests.html uses fixed rates so tests never change.

BRL.source: Banco Central do Brasil, PTAX (sell rate)

INR.source: FBIL USD/INR reference rate (RBI keeps an archive)
INR.note: FBIL page needs JavaScript and a captcha; the RBI archive needs a form. Not read automatically. Value to be sent by hand.
